question: Rast-Goftar, a newspaper, propagated the messages of socio-religious reforms for which of the following societies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parsi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The newspaper Rast Goftar, **also known as Truthteller, advocated for social and religious reforms within the Parsi community. 
 
• Founded in 1854 as an **Anglo-Gujarati newspaper** by **Dadabhai Naoroji and Kharshedji Cama**, its primary aim was to promote social reform initiatives among Parsis in Western India and to elucidate Zoroastrian concepts.
